prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t run a live search from here, but I can tell you how to find certified backflow testers and repair services near Liberty, MO and what to ask so you pick a qualified provider.

Who to contact / where to look
- City of Liberty — Water/Public Works: they can tell you local requirements and may provide a list of approved or commonly used testers.  
- Local plumbing companies and irrigation contractors — many certified backflow testers work for plumbers or irrigation firms.  
- Search Google Maps or Yelp for “backflow testing Liberty MO,” “backflow tester near Liberty, MO,” or “backflow repair Kansas City area” (Liberty is just north of KCMO).  
- Missouri state resources — confirm that the tester is certified to test backflow prevention assemblies in Missouri.

What to verify when you call
- Certification: ask for their Missouri backflow tester certification number and the agency that issued it.  
- Insurance and licensure: general liability and plumber/contractor license if doing repairs.  
- Experience with your assembly type (e.g., RPZ, double-check).  
- Whether they will file the test report with the City/water utility (and provide you a copy).  
- Cost: testing fee and an estimate for common repairs or parts if the device fails.  
- Turnaround and emergency availability if you need a repair quickly.

Typical prices (ballpark)
- Annual test: roughly $50–$150 depending on assembly and region.  
- Repairs: from small part replacement ($50–$200) to full assembly replacement ($300–$1,000+), depending on size/complexity.

- Give sample search queries and filters to use on Google Maps/Yelp.
